name: gr-dvbs2rx
what_it_is: A GNU Radio out-of-tree (OOT) module providing full DVB-S2 transmitter and receiver implementations for software-defined radio (SDR), including PL synchronization, FEC (LDPC/BCH), and MPEG transport stream output. It ships the `dvbs2-tx`, `dvbs2-rx`, and `dvbs2-rec` command-line applications wiring the signal processing blocks together.
components: dvbs2-tx — DVB-S2 transmitter application (Python, wraps gr-dtv Tx blocks)
dvbs2-rx — DVB-S2 receiver application with PL sync, LDPC/BCH FEC, and BBFRAME processing
dvbs2-rec — IQ recording application that saves SigMF-formatted captures from an SDR
GNU Radio OOT shared library with PL synchronization blocks (frame timing, symbol timing, carrier frequency, phase recovery)
SIMD-accelerated LDPC decoder (AVX2, SSE4.1, NEON) from xdsopl/LDPC
BCH decoder (~2.5x faster than original, introduced v1.3.0)
HTTP monitoring server (port 9004) returning receiver metrics as JSON
TSDuck integration for MPEG TS layer processing (tsp, tsdump)
protocols: DVB-S2 (ETSI EN 302 307) — constant coding and modulation (CCM) only; SIS and MIS input streams
MPEG Transport Stream (TS) — input to Tx, output from Rx; processing delegated to TSDuck
SigMF (Signal Metadata Format) — used by dvbs2-rec for IQ recording metadata
DVB-S2 SigMF Extension — custom metadata extension for DVB-S2 recording parameters
Multiprotocol Encapsulation (MPE) — UDP/IP over MPEG TS, supported via TSDuck tsp plugins
HTTP — monitoring server API for on-demand receiver metrics (JSON)
measurement: Signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) — minimum ~2 dB in pilot mode
MPEG TS bitrate (via TSDuck bitrate_monitor plugin)
Periodic console logs via --log and --log-all (JSON) options
On-demand JSON metrics via HTTP GET to monitoring server (curl http://localhost:9004)
configuration: --source: IQ input source — fd, file, rtl, usrp, bladeRF, plutosdr (Rx); fd, file (Tx)
--sink: IQ/TS output sink — fd, file, usrp, bladeRF, plutosdr (Tx); fd, file (Rx)
--freq: SDR tuner center frequency in Hz (e.g., 1316.9e6)
--frame: FEC frame size — normal or short
--pilots / --pilots on/off: enable/disable or assert PL pilot symbols
--snr: simulate AWGN channel at given SNR in dB (Tx only)
--freq-offset: simulate carrier frequency offset in Hz (Tx only)
--out-fd / --in-fd: file descriptor for TS I/O (enables clean stdio separation)
--sps: samples per symbol (dvbs2-rec); combined with --sym-rate sets sample rate
fault_injection: --snr <dB>: inject AWGN noise at specified SNR on the Tx output IQ stream
--freq-offset <Hz>: inject carrier frequency offset into the Tx output IQ stream
modes: Loopback (pipe): dvbs2-tx stdout piped directly into dvbs2-rx stdin — no SDR hardware
File loopback: --source file / --sink file for IQ file-based testing
Live SDR Rx: --source rtl/usrp/bladeRF/plutosdr for real satellite signal reception
Live SDR Tx: --sink usrp/bladeRF/plutosdr for real transmission
IQ recording: dvbs2-rec captures live IQ to SigMF files for offline playback
SigMF playback: dvbs2-rx --source file replays recorded .sigmf-data captures
GUI mode: --gui / --gui-dark / --gui-all for visual signal monitoring
CCM/SIS: single input stream, constant coding and modulation
CCM/MIS: multiple input streams, constant coding and modulation
constraints: Only CCM (constant coding and modulation) is supported; ACM/VCM is not yet implemented across the full pipeline
Only QPSK and 8PSK constellations are supported; 16APSK and 32APSK are not supported
Minimum receivable SNR is ~2 dB and only in pilot mode; lower SNRs and pilotless operation have limited support
RTL-SDR is Rx-only; it cannot be used as a Tx source
bladeRF and PlutoSDR Tx/Rx support is marked experimental
MPEG TS processing is out of scope — the project only inputs/outputs raw TS streams
SIMD acceleration requires AVX2, SSE4.1, or NEON; falls back to scalar otherwise
Primarily validated against Blockstream Satellite (QPSK3/5, CCM/SIS, pilots, 1 Mbaud, 0.2 roll-off, RTL-SDR TCXO)
docker_services: Installs: libusb-1.0-0-dev, libosmosdr-dev, libsndfile1-dev, python3-packaging, tsduck (Blockstream PPA)
Builds rtl-sdr from osmocom/rtl-sdr source (udev rules, kernel driver detach)
Builds gr-dvbs2rx from source with optional cmake_args ARG
notable_absences: No docker-compose.yml — project ships only a single Dockerfile
No ACM/VCM support across the full receiver pipeline
No built-in MPEG TS demuxer or decoder — relies entirely on external TSDuck
No automated CI test for live SDR hardware
